'''Striker One''' was the callsign of a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]] he commanded a [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]] of [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] that was tricked into assisting [[Havoc Squad]] during their assault on the [[Bastion (Corellia)|Bastion]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Striker One appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Trooper class mission on Corellia.<ref name="SWTOR" />
